segments.name: Cellular therapies and specialty biologics
segments.description: Research, product development, manufacture and distribution of cellular therapies and specialty biologics for treatment of specific conditions.
segments.evidence: The Company operates its business primarily in the U.S. in one reportable segment - the research, product development, manufacture and distribution of cellular therapies and specialty biologics for use in the treatment of specific conditions.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for FDA-approved autologous cell therapy products and specialty biologic products used in sports medicine and severe burn care.
revenueModel.evidence: We currently market two U.S. Food and Drug Administration ("FDA") approved autologous cell therapy products and one FDA-approved specialty biologic product in the U.S.
